name: zinput_keyboard_set_raw_event_callback
description: zInput::Keyboard_SetRawEventCallback installs the raw keyboard callback and context globals.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x46f970 yet; the helper currently has functional evidence only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x46f970 validates fastcall callback in ECX and context in EDX stored to g_zInput_KbdRawEventCallback and g_zInput_KbdRawEventCallbackCtx.
The native numeric text-input smoke verifies SetRawKeyboardCapture installs HudUiNumericTextInput::RawKeyboardCallback with the input instance and clears both globals on disable.
